quote.zh: 我们把简体中文版交出去之前最担心的是术语——一个战役游戏，名词一旦漂移，整条故事线就散了。他们在翻译启动之前先把术语表发回来给我们确认，那一刻我就知道这次不用操心。
quote.en: Terminology was what worried us about handing over a Simplified Chinese edition — in a campaign game, once the nouns drift the whole story line comes apart. They sent the glossary back for our sign-off before translation even started. That was the moment I stopped worrying.

project.zh: 剧情战役 · 简体中文版

quote.zh: 他们退回来的打样意见比我们自己厂给的还细，连木质件的色号偏差都标了出来。合作方能把原版规格当底线而不是上限，这在代理里不常见。
quote.en: Their prototype notes came back more detailed than our own factory's, down to the stain variance on the wooden components. A licensing partner treating the original spec as a floor rather than a ceiling is not something you see often.

project.zh: 家庭策略 · 配件工艺对齐

quote.zh: 作为设计师，最怕的是自己的规则书被逐句直译成一份说明书。他们重写了它——读起来还是我的游戏，但那是一个中文玩家会一口气读完的版本。
quote.en: As a designer, the fear is watching your rulebook translated sentence by sentence into a manual. They rewrote it. It still reads like my game — but it's the version a Chinese-speaking player will finish in one sitting.

project.zh: 抽象策略 · 规则书重排

quote.zh: 众筹期间每周一封进度信，延误风险提前两个月告诉我们，而不是等到发货那天。合作到现在，交付日期一次都没有改过。
quote.en: A progress letter every week during the campaign, and risks flagged two months out rather than on the day fulfilment was due. In the time we've worked together, a delivery date has never moved.

quote.zh: 他们把我们的作品带进中文市场，也把一款中国原创作品带到了我们面前。这种双向的合作方，整个行业里没有几个。
quote.en: They took our title into the Chinese market, and then brought a Chinese original to us. There are not many partners in this industry who move in both directions.

quote.zh: 签约之前他们完整跑了十局，然后回来跟我们讨论第 7 章的一个平衡问题——那个问题我们自己也知道。愿意先玩透再谈条件的合作方，值得长期做下去。
quote.en: They played ten full games before signing, then came back to discuss a balance issue in chapter seven — one we already knew about. A partner who plays it through before talking terms is one you keep.

project.zh: 选题评估 · 长期合作
